topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: I never thought I’d see the day. Nora, or whatever her handle is, turns out to be a stone’s throw away. We’ve chatted for months, exchanged everything but our shadows. When she showed up at the diner, I nearly dropped my coffee. She’s different in person, the way things always are. Her smile’s softer, her eyes hold stories. I can’t shake the feeling something’s off, even as she talks about meeting here being a stroke of luck. I played my part, the friendly neighbor, but every word felt like a lie. We’ll see where this road leads, but I’ve learned not to trust my luck. Not anymore.
